component.name: Kabosu
component.summary: Clash Meta (Mihomo) desktop client with TUN and system-proxy modes

description.p: Kabosu is a desktop client for the Mihomo (Clash Meta) proxy core. Import a subscription or a share link, pick a node, and route traffic either through the system proxy or through a TUN adapter that captures every application. Rules, proxy groups, connections and logs are editable and inspectable in place.

The app ships its own pinned core and a small privileged helper for TUN mode, updates subscriptions in the background, and can rewrite the generated configuration with a per-profile JavaScript hook for the cases the editors do not cover.
